weekly.resource: provenanced workload units / verified productive minutes; a relative equity index, not literal time utilization

dutySemantics.travel: fixed-route directed arcs are clock duty; flexible anchor-to-area values are deterministic proximity scores only
dutySemantics.service: fixed appointments consume their full windows; flexible recurring ownership workload points are an equity resource, not clock duty
dutySemantics.waiting: fixed-window non-effort commitment plus non-protected inter-stop slack; flexible ownership windows add no artificial waiting
dutySemantics.workload: the legacy serviceEffortMinutes wire field is fixed-work minutes or dimensionless flexible-ownership workload points according to schedulingMode
dutySemantics.protected: lunch and unavailable intervals; excluded from productive capacity and total duty
dutySemantics.totalDuty: fixed route span minus protected time; flexible workload points and proximity scores are excluded from clock duty

objective.weeklyEquityResource: total provenanced workload / total verified productive minutes across every working day of the slot
objective.serviceEffortWireSemantics: fixed work uses provenanced minutes; flexible_coverage_ownership uses dimensionless production workload points
